text:
Alex: quick heads-up — the weekly KPI deck shows a ~3.2x spike in social CTR after Friday's launch posts, but MQLs and demo requests stayed flat :thinking_face:
Sam: saw that. did the traffic come from paid social or organic?
Marta: looks like organic IG + X. UTM parameters are messy on a couple links.
Alex: can someone pull a source/medium breakdown? I clicked the dashboard and filters look weird.
growth-bot: [automated] anomaly detected on channel: social (CTR +218% vs baseline). alert id: ab-2026-2115
Leo: pulling GA4 and BigQuery now. preliminary: lots of short sessions from ig-referral w/o utm_campaign. probable that some posts used short.link fallback.
Jess: ugh, we used two different linkshorteners in the push. that's on me — should we standardize to one?
Sam: agree. for reporting we need a cleaned attribution layer. propose: map ig-referral + missing UTM -> organic_social_launch for this week only then rerun funnel.
Marta: caution: if we remap too aggressively we risk inflating organic vs paid. what's the window for conversion we're using? 7-day?
Alex: current KPI window is 14-day default. can we test 7 vs 14 to check sensitivity?
Leo: running a quick BigQuery to compare. SQL snippet I'm using:
```
SELECT source, medium, COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) AS users, SUM(event_value) AS leads
FROM `project.events.launch_users`
WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 21 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY source, medium
ORDER BY leads DESC
```
Leo: initial results — ig-referral (no utm) has high sessions but conversion rate 0.6% vs linkedin-paid 2.1%.
Jess: that suggests engagement but low quality. could be content mismatch: launch posts drove clicks but not the right intent.
Sam: also saw that webinar signups didn't increase although traffic spiked. routing check: are all campaign leads flowing to the right Salesforce queue?
Marta: FYI, a handful of webinar registrations were stuck in the old form endpoint last night (thanks to deploy rollback). those won't show up in the dashboard.
Alex: ok two parallel actions: (1) cleaning + remapping UTMs for accurate attribution for the KPI deck; (2) confirm lead routing & missing webinar regs. who owns each?
Sam: I'll take (1) with Leo. will produce a 'clean' attribution table and a short note on methodology for the slide. ETA EOD.
Leo: also adding sensitivity test for 7/14-day windows and dropping 24h low-quality sessions.
Marta: I'll audit the launch post copy + creative and flag posts that used short.link. Jess can we get the list of short links used?
Jess: yeah sending list now: short.link/rdw1, s.link/launch2, go.redwood/cta1
Jess: also adding a note — we used different CTA text between X and IG which could explain intent mismatch.
Sam: perfect. once we have the cleaned numbers we'll update slide 4 (traffic -> lead conversion table) and rerun the weekly KPI deck.
Alex: for the weekly review tomorrow let's surface: net MQL delta after remap, conversion by channel, webinar reg gap, and recommended copy fixes. keep bullets concise.
Marta: + recommend: add a dashboard flag for "link shortener present" so we can filter these sessions easily going forward.
Leo: quick check on routing: I confirmed that leads with missing campaign get assigned to general inbound queue currently — that creates noise. we should default to `unknown_campaign` label not general queue.
Sam: noted. I'll propose that change in inbound-routing RFC and cc SalesOps.
growth-bot: [automated] reminder scheduled: weekly-kpi-review @channel tomorrow 10:00am PT
Alex: thanks everyone. Sam/Leo — ping me when the cleaned table is ready and I'll update the deck. Jess/Marta — please consolidate creative/copy notes in the launch post doc.
Marta: on it, will drop notes into the doc and highlight posts causing the spike.
Jess: done — doc link https://docs.redwood.com/launch/q1-playbook (cc @Marketing) :thumbsup:
Alex: closing thread for now, we'll reconvene in the KPI huddle.
